messages.text:
A direct browser probe on a clean port shows hydration and toast feedback work when the card button is actually clicked, so the remaining e2e failures are stale/blocked hit-target conditions rather than missing React behavior.

I’m updating the smoke test to use the verified interaction path and cleaning the previous local server assumption by using a fresh port.
